svg.aria-label: Three trust zones. The main process holds vault.db with every secret sealed, no OS keyring and no plaintext key; on OpenBSD it unveils only the data, settings and Downloads directories, pledges network, display and audio, and has no exec promise. Prestarted brokers launch only the frozen wn-* helper paths, or run curl, notifications and file dialogs under an inherited locked policy. Helpers wn-image, wn-pdf, wn-archive, wn-mesh, wn-fbx, wn-math, wn-nes and wn-font parse untrusted bytes with a 1 GiB memory limit, stdio pipes and no inherited environment.
